duchabrHome.title: Fleet washing on another level.
duchabrHome.description: An exclusive Dutex solution: DuchaBR is the automated truck wash system developed in Brazil by our engineering team - configured for the fleet, the space and the routine of each operation.

pillars.title: Touchless
pillars.text: Water jets, no brushes or rollers, preserving the paintwork.

pillars.title: Automation
pillars.text: Sensor detection, product dosing and controlled pressure.

pillars.title: Water efficiency
pillars.text: A controlled process that reduces water and supply waste.

pillars.title: Tailor-made
pillars.text: Sized for your fleet, your space and your pace.
